I realised very quickly that although in (1)_______ ways it appears unchanged, in reality hardly anything is the same. All of them are commuters, who leave early every morning for the nearby town. Neither of the farmhouses are attached to a farm these days; the land (3)_______ and is managed by somebody in an office somewhere who has little interest in the village (4)_______. The whole village, (5)_______, has been tidied up so much that it looks no more picturesque than any suburban street.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
options: few
such
many
much
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "many"

Explanation:
☛ The correct answer is "many" because it agrees with the plural noun "ways". "Few" is incorrect as it implies a negative meaning, whereas the context suggests the village appears unchanged in multiple aspects.
☛ "Such" and "much" are inappropriate because "such" is used with adjectives (e.g., "such a way"), and "much" is used with uncountable nouns.
☛ Structurally, "in many ways" is a common phrase indicating multiple aspects of something. This is a frequently tested grammar point in exams.

Exam Tip: In cloze tests, focus on transition words (e.g., however, in fact, therefore). They reveal the sentence’s flow and tone, helping you eliminate incorrect options.
